connector.name: Website MCP
connector.registryDescription: Build, edit, stock, and publish Social AI websites and storefronts via AI chat.
connector.summary: Hosted at socialai.one over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package website-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace one.socialai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SOCIALAI_API_KEY
env.description: Social AI user API key (create at https://socialai.one/settings/api-keys)

env.name: SOCIALAI_API_URL
env.description: Social AI base URL (defaults to https://socialai.one)
